objective: Test whether a fully self-built HalfKP81 evaluation can be strengthened by deterministic self-play, deeper post-game relabeling, and direct paired play gates without changing the live evaluator before superiority is established.
claim_boundary: This file fixes the cycle-zero generation, split, training-arm, and promotion sequence. It is not the sealed shogi-halfkp-selfplay-training-plan-v1 consumed by the trainer because the full train and validation file identities do not exist yet. It is not playing-strength evidence or live-promotion authorization.

bootstrap_research_actor.role: research bootstrap only; not the live champion

sampling_projection_from_20_game_pilot.reason_for_range: The short pilot omitted the long-tail cost visible in the full run. At about 12 minutes the run had completed 135 games and 1592 records, a roughly 35-hour linear projection. The range must continue to be updated from longer steady-state measurements and is not a completion-time promise.

dataset.split_unit: source-game-first with game, opening, and position isolation
dataset.publication: fresh atomic directory; manifest written last

training.selection_boundary: A completed training process or better static loss is not strength evidence. Export and direct play are required.

promotion_sequence.scope: paired direct play against the immutable champion
promotion_sequence.continue_only_if: the preregistered 62 half-point threshold is met
the preregistered one-sided 95-percent lower bound is strictly above 50 percent
the safety lower bound passes and the two-sided 95-percent lower bound is strictly above 50 percent

promotion_sequence.scope: strength calibration outside the self-play training distribution

stop_rules: Stop a candidate at its first failed direct-play gate.
Run at most three self-play cycles.
Stop the family after two consecutive cycle candidates fail promotion.
Do not continue a failed static-data recipe merely by increasing epochs.
Never write public/shogi-nnue-weights.bin from generation, dataset preparation, training, export, or an incomplete gate.
